michelle: Heads up — the streaming + retry + pagination snippets across py/ts/go have drifted. Also found a broken link in the pagination page (anchors to old header). Can someone take the lead on a compact polyglot example we can use in the migration guide?

adrian: I can take this. do we want separate files per lang or a single page with 3 inline snippets? i vote single page for the cookbook + language tabs. :thumbsup:

sam: re tests: note that our snippets are used by the docs CI (docs-snippet-check). last run failed on the Go example (fmt + concurrency edge). i'll paste the failing log if helpful.

june: @adrian single page is fine. main ask: show streaming resume token + idempotent retries + paginate on top-level fetch. tiny code samples, no huge helper libs.
adrian: ok here's a draft for the python streaming + retry piece (short):

```python
# resume + retry (pseudo)
from redwood import Client
client = Client()

stream = client.stream("gpt-xx", prompt="...", max_tokens=1024)
for chunk in stream:
    if chunk.type == 'resume_token':
        token = chunk.token
        # persist token
    print(chunk.text, end='')

# on retry use saved token
resp = client.stream("gpt-xx", resume_token=token)
```

adrian: will add TS/Go analogs and pare them down.

michelle: perfect. small request: include an explicit note about token TTL and that resume tokens are best-effort (don't promise exactly-once). also call out cost/latency tradeoffs for batching vs realtime.

sam: for Go snippet, the concurrency bug was because we used the same buffer across goroutines. i'll prepare a fixed snippet using channels + context and push as a patch on the repo.

kevin: when you open the PR, add the docs-lint step to the PR template so authors run the snippet validator locally: `make docs-validate-snippets`. That cut down flakey commits last month.

adrian: noted. plan: create branch `docs/snippet/compact-retry-cookbook`, add three small snippets, update pagination page anchors, update one-line note on resume-token semantics. will ping for reviews. target PR by EOD tomorrow.

michelle: tagging acceptance criteria to keep it actionable:
- polyglot page with language tabs and 3 compact snippets (py/ts/go)
- tests pass in docs CI (snippet-check)
- broken pagination anchor fixed and link updated in migration guide
- short callout about resume token TTL + idempotency

june: adding a tiny sample for pagination cursor handling to reuse across all three: please copy in each snippet the same variable naming so we can grep tests.

adrian: will standardize on `cursor_id` / `resume_token` / `batch_size`.
